recommendations: Reuse ReSpace mesh VBL with strict failure counting plus LayoutGPT bbox OOB; record pitch/tolerances/units separately.
OptiScene needs exact sizes; Holodeck places after retrieving actual-size assets. Label these task differences instead of silently giving GT dimensions.
With fixed exact inventory category KL is trivial; report exact ID/count coverage, mesh fit and all-input end-to-end success.
CLIP-FID, room-type CLIP, GPT judge and lexical PMS measure different things and do not certify support/access/navigation.
Generation-only code release is not full paper evaluation reproduction.
